This Evo delivers sharp, track-capable performance while still offering reasonable highway manners and fuel economy for a high-output sport sedan.

Steering wheel mounted cruise control makes longer drives easier by holding your chosen speed for reduced fatigue and steadier fuel use without taking your hands far from the wheel.

All-wheel drive provides improved traction in rain, snow, or loose surfaces so you feel more confident accelerating and cornering in changing road conditions.

The full-time 4-wheel/all-wheel drive system constantly sends power to all four wheels, delivering predictable grip and helping maintain control without the need for driver intervention.

Variable valve timing adjusts engine breathing across RPMs to balance stronger acceleration with better efficiency and cleaner emissions, enhancing everyday drivability.

A DOHC valvetrain helps the engine rev more freely and produce stronger top-end power, translating to a more engaging, responsive driving experience.

Using premium fuel lets the turbocharged engine perform at its best, ensuring crisp throttle response and maintaining peak output when you want maximum performance.

The intercooled turbocharger forces denser, cooler air into the cylinders for added power and quicker acceleration when you put your foot down.

Sequential multi-point electronic fuel injection improves cold starts, refines throttle response, and supports cleaner, more efficient combustion under varying conditions.

Wireless audio streaming keeps your playlists and podcasts available without cables, so you can enjoy hands-free entertainment on the go.

High-intensity discharge low beam headlamps produce a bright, daylight-like beam that improves night visibility and reduces eye strain on long after-dark drives.

An ignition immobilizer adds a passive layer of security so the vehicle wont start unless the correct key is present, helping deter theft and offering peace of mind.

Wireless connectivity Bluetooth integrates your phone for hands-free calling and simple media control, helping you stay connected while keeping your focus on the road.

External memory control lets you access music or media stored on drives or memory sticks directly from the car, making long trips more enjoyable with your own library at hand.

Digital/analog instrumentation blends traditional needle gauges with digital readouts so you get clear, immediate information while retaining an intuitive cabin layout.

- Connected Navigation system with 3-year trial included

The Reserve trim represents the pinnacle of Navigator engineering, combining a powerful V6 engine with intelligent 10-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive for responsive performance across varied driving conditions. This black exterior finish presents a commanding, sophisticated presence on any road or driveway.

Interior refinement starts with the available Luxury Package, which includes a 30-way power seat system with active motion technology that adjusts to your body's position. Heated and ventilated seating extends to the second row, ensuring passenger comfort on long journeys. The panoramic vista roof floods the cabin with natural light, creating an airy atmosphere throughout the three-row layout.

Entertainment and connectivity reach premium levels through the Revel Ultima audio system, delivering 28 speakers and proprietary QuantumLogic 3D surround sound technology. The SYNC 4 system integrates seamlessly with your devices, while connected navigation provides real-time route optimization. SiriusXM with 360L keeps you entertained with satellite radio's full-spectrum programming.

For owners who tow, the Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package transforms this Navigator into a capable hauling vehicle. The 8700 lb maximum towing capacity accommodates substantial trailers, while Pro-Trailer Backup Assist 2.0 simplifies reversing with a trailer attached. Integrated technologies include trailer sway control, brake controller integration, and smart trailer tow features. The electronic traction assist system provides additional wheel slip control during demanding towing scenarios.

Practical thoughtfulness defines Navigator ownership. All-weather floor liners with carpet floor mats protect the cabin from the elements. The tiered cargo area management system features a 4-way configurable partition for organizing gear. Active park assist technology makes maneuvering easier in tight spaces, while the power liftgate provides convenient access to the generous cargo hold.

This black Navigator Reserve combines luxury appointments, practical towing capability, and the reliability you expect from the Lincoln nameplate. With its comprehensive equipment group, premium audio, and sophisticated climate control, it stands ready to elevate your driving experience. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the appointment-rich interior, test the responsive powertrain, and discover why the Navigator Reserve remains a preferred choice for families and professionals alike.

description:
Discover the capability and refinement of the 2026 Hyundai Santa Cruz Limited, a truck that redefines versatility for modern drivers who demand both practicality and premium comfort.

- Bose Premium Audio System with 8 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Power moonroof for open-air enjoyment
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with leather trim
- Heated steering wheel for winter driving comfort
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Navigation system with rearview camera
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone climate zones
- Power driver and passenger seats with memory function
- 20-inch alloy wheels
- Leather-trimmed steering wheel and shift knob
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with auto-leveling capability
- Speed-sensing power steering
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Rain-sensing windshield wipers

The 2026 Santa Cruz Limited arrives in clean White exterior paint complemented by body-color bumpers, heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, and a rear step bumper designed for everyday accessibility. The autoleveling suspension works in concert with four-wheel independent suspension geometry to deliver a smooth ride whether navigating city streets or rougher terrain. With fully automatic headlights featuring delay-off functionality and an auto high-beam system, visibility remains optimal in changing light conditions.

Step inside the cabin and experience the thoughtful appointments throughout. The heated and ventilated front bucket seats provide personalized comfort while the power-adjustable driver seat with memory settings adapts to your preference. The leather-trimmed interior includes a heated steering wheel and leather shift knob, while overhead reading lights, front and rear, ensure visibility when needed. The rear seat center armrest and split-folding rear configuration maximize flexibility for cargo or passengers.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily drive. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps you connected through the touchscreen interface, while the navigation system with integrated rearview camera enhances safety during parking and reversing maneuvers. The SiriusXM-equipped premium audio system with multiple speakers delivers quality sound throughout the cabin, controlled conveniently via steering wheel mounted audio controls.

Engineered for capable performance, this Santa Cruz Limited combines a 2.5L inline-four engine delivering 18 city and 25 highway MPG with eight-speed automatic transmission and SHIFTRONIC manual override capability. All-wheel drive provides traction and stability, while comprehensive safety systems including dual front impact airbags, front and rear side airbags, overhead airbags, and electronic stability control work together to protect occupants.

Visit our showroom today to see the 2026 Hyundai Santa Cruz Limited and discover why this truck offers the perfect balance of capability, technology, and everyday luxury for discerning buyers.

Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps the driver and front passenger comfortable.

For more than three decades, the Miata has been the answer to a simple question: what's the most fun you can have on four wheels without spending a fortune? The 2017 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF Grand Touring takes that legendary formula and adds a dramatic power-retractable fastback roof and a comprehensive list of creature comforts. Finished in Mazda's sophisticated Machine Gray Metallic and showing about 54,000 miles, this RF is ready to make every drive feel like an occasion.

RF stands for Retractable Fastback. Instead of a traditional soft top, the RF uses a power-folding hardtop that tucks its roof panels neatly away behind the seats while the sculpted rear buttresses stay in place. With the roof up, you get the quiet, secure feel and sleek profile of a coupe. With the roof down, the open-air experience feels like a classic targa-style sports car. Just as important, the Miata is famously easy to own. It's efficient, reliable, and affordable to maintain, with a reputation for durability that makes it as practical as a daily driver as it is on a winding weekend road. That rare combination of pure driving joy and everyday dependability is why the Miata has earned such a devoted following across generations. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The fourth-generation MX-5 was widely praised at launch as a return to the Miata's lightweight, driver-focused roots, earning acclaim for its crisp handling, eager engine, and beautifully sculpted KODO design. When the RF arrived, reviewers highlighted its striking fastback styling and added refinement with the roof up, calling it a more grown-up yet still thoroughly entertaining take on the formula. Its tight cabin and small trunk are the most common trade-offs.
